description: Machine-readable expectations for CPD sample files. Phase-2 ETL tests assert these. Counts verified by running worker/etl/validate over the fixtures.

sales_edge.csv.note: Boundary rows: leap-day, zero price (rejected: price must be > 0), 3-decimal price, unicode customer id, max-int qty (rejected), case/whitespace variants (accepted), ISO datetime, GBP row, repeating decimal, month-end, SKU/name mismatch (rejected)

sales_dirty.csv.note: Accepted by design (lenient rules): O-2016 mixed date 09/06/2026; O-2017 uppercase CARD; O-2018 lowercase usd; O-2019 padded product name (trimmed); O-2020 empty trailing column (ignored); O-2023 clean control row

sales_good.json.note: JSON array of the 20 sales_good.csv rows; same expectations

sales_scale_10k.csv.note: generate.py --rows 10000 --dirty-ratio 0.05 --seed 42; dirty rows rotate 8 defect modes
